sourceAuthority.name: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02) Exam Guide
sourceAuthority.examComposition: 50 scored questions and 15 unscored questions; multiple-choice and multiple-response; passing scaled score 700
sourceAuthority.scopeRule: Task statements and Appendix A are authoritative. The published in-scope and out-of-scope service lists are non-exhaustive and subject to change; services were judged by their mapped task-statement category and no explicitly out-of-scope service was retained.

inventory.pbqOrLabContent: NOT APPLICABLE — CLF-C02 uses multiple-choice and multiple-response questions; GSA application practice is supplied by Objective Sweeps, mixed review, Captain Challenges, and Practice Exams.

officialScopeCorrections.correction: Added explicit economies-of-scale recognition within the official 1.1 lesson boundary.
Added CloudFormation automation and managed-service recognition for Amazon RDS, Amazon ECS, Amazon EKS, and DynamoDB.
Added the official security-group and network-ACL security-feature examples.
Added public internet, AWS VPN, and AWS Direct Connect connectivity-option recognition.
Added AWS Local Zones, AWS Wavelength, and AWS Global Accelerator to global-infrastructure and edge recognition.
Added the official Amazon CloudFront and AWS Global Accelerator edge-service comparison.
Completed named customer-engagement, developer-tool, and IoT coverage: Activate, IQ, AMS, AppConfig, Cloud9, CloudShell, CodeArtifact, CodeCommit, CodeDeploy, CodeStar, and IoT Greengrass.
Added AWS Billing Conductor use-case and comparison coverage.
